title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.

AI.title_zh: SafeDriveVLA：面向冲突感知端到端自动驾驶的导航条件世界模型梦想
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）模型在自动驾驶领域正受到关注，它们继承了大语言模型（LLM）的常识先验，并将导航接口从固定的指令集扩展为自由形式的自然语言指令。然而，这种开放式接口暴露出一类新的脆弱性面：注意力不集中的驾驶员可能发出在当前位置下不安全的指令，而恶意用户可能故意发出危险指令。我们提出了首个将导航跟随与冲突感知以及对抗鲁棒性放在一起评估的基准套件。现有 VLA 在这两方面均表现不足：SimLingo 在闭环中无法完成任何语言指令的车道变换，且所有模型在冲突信号下均急剧退化。我们提出 SafeDriveVLA，这是首个（1）显式预测三级导航遵从模式以将冲突推理与动作生成解耦，并（2）使用导航条件世界模型梦想来为该预测提供信息的驾驶 VLA。与先前展开专家动作或规划动作的世界模型不同，我们的世界模型梦想的是严格遵循导航信号，从而显示遵循何时是安全的。SafeDriveVLA 在 Bench2Drive 上达到 88.16 驾驶得分（Driving Score，DS）与 68.64% 成功率（Success Rate，SR），相比最佳 SimLingo 变体将闭环语言跟随提升 49.3%，并将不安全指令下的碰撞从 60 次减少到 38 次。视频演示可在我们的项目页面获取。

title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
summary: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

AI.title_zh: DynThinker：统一静态 3D 与动态 4D 空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 实现通用空间智能需要统一理解静态 3D 与动态 4D。然而，我们发现现有模型难以在两者上同时表现出色：3D 后训练会削弱动态理解，而 4D 专用模型往往缺乏强大的静态 3D 推理能力。我们的分析表明，这种空间—动态干扰在各参数组之间高度不均匀，静态能力与动态能力之间的平衡对后层 MLP 的变化尤为敏感。为解决这种干扰，我们提出 DynThinker，一个用于共同增强静态与动态空间推理的统一框架。解耦指数滑动平均（Decoupled Exponential Moving Average, D-EMA）施加可配置的分组平均，以约束对干扰敏感的预训练参数的漂移，同时保留能力增强的灵活性。空间—动态融合（Spatial-Dynamic Fusion, SDF）通过语义引导，选择性地将来自动态几何编码器的空间先验与时间先验整合进 VLM 的中间表示，从而与 D-EMA 形成互补。在涵盖九个静态 3D 与动态 4D 基准的十项指标上，DynThinker 在所有被评估模型中取得了最高的平均分。值得注意的是，DynThinker 在 ReVSI 上达到 56.0，在 DSR-Bench 上达到 67.2，并在 DSI-Bench 的逐样本（sample-wise）与分组（group-wise）评估协议下分别达到 51.2 和 40.1，在统一模型中于所有四项评估上均刷新了所比较开源模型的最先进结果。

title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
summary: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

AI.title_zh: GeoThinker-$F$：面向快速空间智能的内生预测性世界表征
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的几何感知多模态大语言模型（MLLM）日益依赖外部3D编码器来提供结构先验，但在推理时执行这些额外的编码器路径会带来显著的延迟和计算开销。我们提出GeoThinker-$F$，一个高效框架，通过将因果MLLM隐藏状态转换为预测性潜在世界表征，将时空感知内化。我们的关键洞见是：中间语义表征包含足够的信息来预测当前几何的有用表征与未来语义，而无需精确复现来自专用3D编码器的特征。为实现这一想法，GeoThinker-$F$采用解耦的两阶段训练策略。在第一阶段，MLLM主干被冻结，轻量级潜在帧预测（LFP）头从离线3D几何专家和下一帧语义目标中学习。在第二阶段，外部专家被移除，模型通过专门的空间接地时序（SGT）融合模块进行联合优化，以生成并选择性整合其自预测先验。大量评估表明，GeoThinker-$F$消除了运行时对外部3D几何编码器的依赖，同时在多样化的空间智能基准上保持有竞争力的性能。它实现了最高$3.6\times$的推理加速，将延迟从$1.45\,\mathrm{s}$降至$0.40\,\mathrm{s}$，同时保持强劲的空间推理性能。

title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.

AI.title_zh: 面向三维高斯溅射的前馈多视图特征编码
AI.abstract_zh: 前馈三维高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting，3DGS）方法能够在单次前向传播中从稀疏多视图图像高效重建三维场景，而无需针对特定场景进行优化。然而，现有的前馈场景编码流水线首先生成完整的高斯表示，然后分别对其几何与外观属性进行编码，往往涉及不可微操作。由此产生的“先生成后压缩”流水线需要复杂的属性专用编解码器设计，并且由于限制了跨属性冗余的利用而制约了率失真性能。我们提出了面向高斯溅射的多视图特征编码（multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting，MFGS），一种端到端的前馈场景编码框架。MFGS 并不压缩显式的高斯表示，而是从输入图像中提取多视图特征，并将其编码为紧凑的比特流。通过端到端的率失真训练，MFGS 学习到能够联合表示几何与外观的紧凑多视图特征，使接收端能够从解码后的特征预测高斯属性。我们进一步引入重要性引导的高斯选择，以适应不同的渲染预算，使接收端能够从同一比特流中调整用于渲染的高斯数量。在 RE10K、ACID 和 DL3DV 上，以 BD-rate 衡量，MFGS 相较于“先生成后压缩”流水线实现了 99.76–99.86% 的比特率节省，同时将总 GMACs 降低 52–55%，并提供了约 12 倍的端到端加速。

title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
summary: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.

AI.title_zh: 任意时间，任意空间：一种以世界状态为中心的智能体视频生成框架
AI.abstract_zh: 长篇幅的智能体视频生成必须将剧本转化为镜头，并在非连续的请求之间保持空间与时间上的一致性。在镜头之间传递提示词或近期帧，无法为重新访问某一场景提供共享的空间参照，也无法为回放先前事件提供带时间索引的记录。我们提出任意时间、任意空间（Any Time, Any Space, ATAS），它将剧本编译为带有明确地点、摄像机与事件时间引用的镜头请求。在生成之前，它从由已注册静态几何构成的场景记忆，以及按场景、事件和时间索引的动态观测事件记忆中检索相关证据。生成之后，ATAS 对片段进行重建与注册。仅当审查与状态检查接受该观测时，它才更新记忆，而成片交付仍独立于记忆准入。在四种视频生成器上，ATAS 提升了所有已报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并为每个骨干模型取得了最高的综合基准分数。它还在目标图像空间重访任务上优于所比较的智能体方法与三维引导方法，在三项事件重现标准上领先，并在全部六项标准上获得最高的人工评分。视频结果与代码可在我们的项目页面获取：https://lhmd.top/atas/。

title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
summary: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.

AI.title_zh: 交互式视频生成中的推测采样
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视频生成通常依赖较小的双向块来降低响应延迟。然而，我们的初步实验表明，更大的块可以提升视频质量，并更好地利用 GPU 并行性，使得在采样时间仅适度增加的情况下能够采样更多潜变量。受这些观察的启发，我们提出了推测采样（Speculative Sampling），一种将大双向窗口的建模能力与小双向窗口的低延迟交互相结合的方案。它通过附加噪声潜变量作为填充来扩展建模窗口，并缓存由此产生的预测，以便在条件保持不变时复用。预测被增量式地交付，而未提交的未来仍可被替换。我们的延迟分析表明，这消除了由块边界施加的等待时间下界，将优化重点从减小块大小转向加速每块的采样。因此，双向窗口大小成为用于联合优化视觉质量与采样时间的决策变量，而不再是对低延迟交互的必要约束。这为在交互式流式系统中服务大型双向模型开辟了一条无需复杂流式后训练的路径。

title: KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation
summary: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage: https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: KinoGen：通过运动学接地的视频生成实现可定制的人形机器人移动-操作参考
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 KinoGen，一个通过运动学接地的视频生成来合成可定制人形机器人移动-操作（loco-manipulation）参考的框架。KinoGen 以模拟任务实例中目标机器人与物体的标定渲染为条件，驱动一个预训练视频生成器，并通过将相同的模型拟合到生成的双视角视频来恢复参考，从而使该参考在构造上即位于机器人构型空间中，无需人体代理或重定向（retargeting）。身体、手部和物体先验为重建提供初始化，而针对跨视角证据的直接优化对其进行细化。由于编辑后的关键帧不过是另一种渲染状态，用户可以指定一个目标物体位姿，围绕编辑后的关键帧重新生成视频，并获得精确满足该位姿的参考。在八项移动-操作任务中，KinoGen 相比基于视频的基线方法产生更低的穿透和足部滑移，并保留超过 90% 的标注接触；其定制参考满足每一个指定目标，且穿透显著少于直接插值。在合成的参考上训练的跟踪策略被部署于配备灵巧手的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。项目网页：https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/。

title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
summary: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

AI.title_zh: 迈向智能体机器人：模型、数据、环境与运行框架
AI.abstract_zh: 基础模型正在推动机器人智能发生范式转变，从低层次的动作预测转向对数据收集、模型训练、任务规划与真实世界执行的目标导向编排。我们将这一新兴范式刻画为智能体机器人（agentic robots），其中智能体针对人类指令进行推理，与机器人环境交互，自主纠正执行错误，并动态调整运行策略。尽管该领域发展迅速，当前研究之间却缺乏良好衔接。研究人员对于如何将不同的智能体功能组合成一个完整的机器人系统尚无一致看法。本文对现有智能体机器人研究进行了统一的综述。我们首先梳理从机器人策略到智能体系统的发展脉络，涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型以及世界-动作模型。随后，我们阐明智能体机器人的定义与范围，并将现有研究按模型（Model）、数据（Data）、环境（Environment）与运行框架（Harness）四个功能域组织为十七个类别。在这些功能域中，我们考察智能体如何塑造模型学习与机器人决策，如何收集与整理机器人数据，如何为学习与评估构建世界、任务与测试，以及如何为机器人使用组织各项能力。最后，我们讨论开放性挑战并勾勒未来研究方向。展望未来，我们希望本工作有助于更清晰地理解智能体机器人，并支持新的方法，使其更有能力、更可靠、更具适应性。

title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
summary: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

AI.title_zh: 先看再恢复：面向智能体图像恢复的“行动前预测”学习
AI.abstract_zh: 用于混合退化图像恢复的智能体通常只有在运行工具之后才能学到该工具对图像做了什么：失败的调用浪费计算，而有害的输出直到为时已晚才被察觉。我们提出 PreActIR，一个在执行前预测工具后果的智能体式恢复框架。对于每个候选工具，一个以工具为条件的世界模型会预测残差退化、图像质量与保真度的变化，同时预测有害风险以及预测的不确定性。智能体执行排名最高的候选工具，一个独立的验证器会在智能体根据观测到的状态重新规划之前，提交或回滚其输出。PreActIR 还会审查性能受限是源于选择器还是源于候选空间，并将有针对性的工具适配作为一种受控方式来扩展该空间加以研究。在一项固定候选池、验证器和预算，并采用带参考标注的退化状态的受控评估中，与反应式、先执行再评估的试错方法相比，PreActIR 使用的真实工具调用少 42.5%，被拒绝的调用少 63.4%，同时将 Y-PSNR 提高了 0.92 dB。

title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
summary: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

AI.title_zh: InfiniSplat v2：从任意视角分析与改进前馈式3DGS
AI.abstract_zh: 前馈式高斯重建直接从输入图像构建三维场景以用于新视角渲染，但从预测几何中学习高斯属性、以在大视角变化下实现高质量渲染仍然具有挑战性。我们分析了高斯属性学习中的局限性，并提出了 InfiniSplat v2，其通过架构与训练上的改动提升了渲染质量。我们的方法利用冻结的几何分支将几何与属性预测解耦，在训练期间使用真值相机位姿对齐预测的高斯，并采用大角度目标视角监督。在六个数据集上，同一个训练模型的前馈输出在所评估的方法中，于位姿条件（pose-conditioned）与无位姿（pose-free）两种设置下均取得了最优的平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS。在位姿条件设置下，与所评估的最强基线相比，平均 LPIPS 和 DISTS 分别下降 25.8% 和 32.9%。我们进一步发现，仅使用图像重建监督学习得到的不透明度会抑制几何上不一致的点。项目主页：https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.

AI.title_zh: 失败后反思：面向具身空间智能的类脑自演化智能体
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在空间推理方面已取得实质性进展，而自演化智能体通过从交互中学习，进一步将这些能力扩展到具身环境。然而，当前的自演化在具身空间任务中仍尤为困难，基于部分视觉证据的复杂且多步的决策使得难以确定一次执行为何失败。失败可能源于感知错误、探索不足或规划不当，但仅凭执行反馈很少能揭示究竟是哪个环节负有责任。结果，仅仅积累交互经验反而可能强化无效策略。为解决这一问题，我们提出 HiMeco，一种受大脑启发的、面向具身空间智能的自演化智能体，其灵感来自元认知监控与海马体记忆巩固。通过海马体-元认知反思（Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection），HiMeco 对感知-探索-规划（perception-exploration-planning, PEP）中的失败进行诊断，然后比较各次执行尝试，以推导出可复用的策略以及避免重复错误的指导。它还将交互程序抽象为参数化技能，并使用证据契约与基于执行的验证来决定这些技能的保留与复用。这些策略与技能指导后续交互，记忆仅在轮次之间更新，模型参数保持冻结。HiMeco 在 ESI-Bench 上取得了最先进的性能，并且在不进行演化的情况下将 EmbSpatial-Bench 上的准确率提升了 3.94 个百分点。

title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
summary: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.

AI.title_zh: PAWA：面向多智能体的全景动作条件世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 多玩家世界模型必须预测若干玩家的独立动作如何改变共享环境，包括发生在某位玩家当前视野之外的变化。视角（point-of-view，POV）视频只有在这些变化进入其视野之后才能捕捉到它们，而全景视频则记录各个观察方向上的周围环境，并在近期的世界模型中被用作世界状态的中间表示。因此，学习这一任务需要相互交互的玩家的、与其动作同步的 POV 视频与全景视频，然而在 Minecraft 这一已被确立的测试平台中——玩家在其中于共享、可修改的 3D 世界中独立行动——尚无现有数据集提供这种组合。我们提出 PAWA，一个用于动作条件全景多玩家世界建模的数据集与框架。该数据集将每位玩家的 POV 视频与世界稳定后的全景视频以及对齐的动作配对。其分布式流水线将 CPU 游戏过程采集与 GPU 渲染解耦，可扩展到超过 64 名同时在线玩家，并能在新的观察配置下重新渲染每个已录制的会话，而无需重放游戏过程。在此数据集上，我们开发了一个双塔模型，它联合预测 POV 视频与全景视频，并通过交叉注意力耦合这两个流，该交叉注意力在共享世界坐标系中对观察同一方向的 token 进行对齐。我们进一步引入一种二次相位玩家编码，在相同嵌入维度下可提供比现有旋转编码多得多的玩家编码。实验表明，PAWA 在 POV 预测质量上优于最先进的多玩家世界模型，同时还能生成高保真的全景预测。该数据集与采集流水线已开源，以支持对多玩家世界模型的进一步研究。

title: ObjDream: Guiding Vision-Language-Action Models with Object-Level Understanding and Future State Prediction
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling robots to generate actions from visual observations and language instructions. However, most existing VLA models still operate on image-level visual representations inherited from pretrained vision-language backbones, while lacking fine-grained object understanding for manipulation. As a result, their robustness can degrade under out-of-distribution object layouts, clutter, and background variations. To address these limitations, we introduce ObjDream, an object-centric VLA framework centered on object-level understanding and future object state prediction. ObjDream uses a spatio-temporal object encoder to organize visual observations into temporal object slots, where persistent object identity and dynamic object state are represented through separate channels. These structured object representations are inserted into the token sequence of the vision-language model (VLM), where identity-guided routing modulates VLM attention to the corresponding object tokens. In addition, an action-conditioned object dynamics module predicts compact future object states relevant to manipulation during training, explicitly supervising object state evolution under robot actions without requiring future prediction at inference. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 show that ObjDream improves generalization under diverse distribution shifts and scene perturbations. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate that ObjDream transfers to physical manipulation settings with novel object arrangements and background changes.

AI.title_zh: ObjDream：以对象级理解与未来状态预测引导视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作的一种强大范式，使机器人能够根据视觉观测和语言指令生成动作。然而，大多数现有 VLA 模型仍基于继承自预训练视觉-语言骨干网络的图像级视觉表征运行，同时缺乏用于操作的细粒度对象理解。因此，其鲁棒性在分布外对象布局、杂乱场景和背景变化下可能下降。为解决这些局限，我们提出 ObjDream，一个以对象为中心的 VLA 框架，其核心是对象级理解与未来对象状态预测。ObjDream 使用时空对象编码器将视觉观测组织为时序对象槽（temporal object slots），其中持续的对象身份与动态的对象状态通过相互分离的通道表示。这些结构化的对象表征被插入视觉-语言模型（VLM）的词元序列中，其中身份引导的路由（identity-guided routing）调节 VLM 对相应对象词元的注意力。此外，一个以动作为条件的对象动力学模块在训练期间预测与操作相关的紧凑未来对象状态，从而在机器人动作下显式监督对象状态的演化，而无需在推理时进行未来预测。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上的实验表明，ObjDream 在多种分布偏移和场景扰动下提升了泛化能力。真实世界机器人实验进一步表明，ObjDream 能够迁移到具有新颖对象布局和背景变化的物理操作场景中。

title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
summary: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.

AI.title_zh: 一瞥强制：让双向扩散模型一瞥之间实现自回归
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归生成是实时、因果视频合成的基础，也是视频世界模型的骨干。当今的主流方法将一个双向扩散模型蒸馏为一个因果的少步学生模型，但现有流程使这种转换代价高昂得难以承受，需要离线的概率流常微分方程（Probability Flow ODE，PF-ODE）轨迹，耗费数万 GPU 小时和数 TB 存储。我们表明这一过程可以被显著地变得更加高效。将这种效率推向极致，我们将轨迹监督缩减为单个样本，即尽可能最严格的设置，并发现这会导致严重的质量崩溃。我们将其归因于教师轨迹的几何结构：高噪声区间主导语义布局与运动，低噪声区间主导精细纹理，二者表现出根本不同的曲率与优化行为，因此单一的、整体式的学生模型无法同时拟合二者，从而导致严重的表征干扰。受此启发，我们提出 Glance Forcing，一个轻量级蒸馏框架，将去噪轨迹解耦为两个互补的慢速与快速专家，每个专家由为其量身定制的、阶段特定的目标引导，同时保持预训练教师完全冻结。这种解耦进一步揭示了几步蒸馏背后的一般机制：PF-ODE 蒸馏主要拉直少步轨迹的几何结构，而随后的分布匹配阶段独立地决定分布质量。仅使用一条 PF-ODE 轨迹，Glance Forcing 就已超越完全训练的最先进基线，将 VBench Total 分数从 84.04 提升至 84.22，同时将轨迹收集成本从数千 GPU 小时削减至约一个 A100-GPU 小时，并在动态程度、VisionReward 和指令遵循方面取得明显更大的增益，且人类评分者相较于强基线给出一致的偏好。

title: OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions
summary: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.

AI.title_zh: OneLA：从潜在动作中学习多重世界
AI.abstract_zh: 跨多样领域学习世界模型需要一个统一的控制空间，然而动作接口在不同领域间各不相同，且动作标注往往稀缺。直接从视频中学习到的潜在动作（latent actions）为无需显式动作监督而建立这样一个空间提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，跨领域学习共享的潜在动作仍然具有挑战性，因为外观、具身体现（embodiment）和动力学方面的差异会使领域特定的视觉线索与可迁移的转迁结构纠缠在一起。为此，我们提出 OneLA，一个简单的框架，它通过共享的正交字典（orthogonal dictionary）和共同的预测目标来学习连续的潜在动作，在潜在动作预训练期间无需任务特定的设计或跨领域对齐损失。这些潜在动作为世界模型提供了共享的条件接口，并通过轻量级适配器（adapters）将原生控制命令映射到同一空间。以潜在动作和当前视觉状态为条件，世界模型预测上下文相关的转迁，以实现可控的推演（rollout）。OneLA 改善了跨领域的动作读出（action readout），并将动作循环转迁旋转误差（action cycle-transfer rotation error）较最强评估基线降低了 24.8%。一项联合训练对比进一步显示，真实场景生成的人类偏好分数 v3（Human Preference Score v3，HPSv3）提升了 20.5%。这些结果表明了一条通向通用世界模型的路径，即从多样视频中学习，并通过潜在动作空间支持灵活控制。

title: Tactile-Guided Robot Learning: From Representation Learning to Foundation Models
summary: Tactile sensing is becoming central to robust, adaptive, and dexterous robotic manipulation. Beyond its traditional role in contact detection and reactive control, touch is increasingly used to learn transferable representations, condition manipulation policies, and support embodied physical reasoning. Yet existing surveys largely emphasize tactile hardware and perception, leaving the rapid shift toward learning-based tactile manipulation insufficiently synthesized. This paper reviews tactile-guided skill learning from a learning-centric perspective, organized by the functional role of touch across the learning and control pipeline. We examine tactile representation and policy learning, tactile foundation models, predictive and adaptive control, and generalization across objects, tasks, sensors, embodiments, and simulation-to-real transfer. Across these directions, we identify common design principles and remaining challenges in learning transferable physical representations, integrating semantic reasoning with contact-level control, and scaling tactile learning across heterogeneous data and hardware. Finally, we outline emerging directions toward tactile foundation and world models that can predict, reason about, and adapt physical interactions. Together, this review characterizes the transition of touch from a task-specific feedback signal toward a core modality for general-purpose embodied intelligence. An accompanying database of the reviewed literature and associated resources is available at https://sites.google.com/view/touch-in-robot-learning-review.

AI.title_zh: 触觉引导的机器人学习：从表征学习到基础模型
AI.abstract_zh: 触觉感知正成为稳健、自适应且灵巧的机器人操作的核心。除了在接触检测与反应式控制中的传统作用外，触觉越来越多地被用于学习可迁移的表征、为操作策略提供条件，并支持具身物理推理。然而，现有综述在很大程度上侧重于触觉硬件与感知，对向基于学习的触觉操作这一快速转变的梳理尚不充分。本文从以学习为中心的视角综述触觉引导的技能学习，并依据触觉在学习与控制流程中的功能角色进行组织。我们考察触觉表征与策略学习、触觉基础模型、预测性与自适应控制，以及在物体、任务、传感器、具身形态和仿真到现实迁移方面的泛化。在这些方向中，我们识别出在学习可迁移的物理表征、将语义推理与接触级控制相结合，以及跨异构数据和硬件扩展触觉学习方面的共同设计原则与尚存挑战。最后，我们概述了迈向触觉基础模型与世界模型的新兴方向，这些模型能够预测、推理并适应物理交互。总之，本综述刻画了触觉从任务特定的反馈信号向通用具身智能核心模态的转变。所综述文献及相关资源的配套数据库见 https://sites.google.com/view/touch-in-robot-learning-review。

title: DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing
summary: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.title_zh: DreamHMR：从视频生成到通过结构聚焦的人体运动建模
AI.abstract_zh: 人体网格恢复（HMR）为理解人体运动提供了几何基础，但从视频中准确重建身体运动与精细手部关节仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在遮挡与部分可见情形常见的真实场景中。视频生成预训练为该任务提供了丰富的空间与时间先验，但其对视觉合成的侧重使这些表示与显式人体几何之间存在差距。我们提出 DreamHMR，一个将视频生成先验适配于完整身体与手部重建的通用框架。它遵循从全局到局部的策略，首先将视频表示建立在人体几何之上，然后利用可靠的局部证据细化身体与手部细节。全局身体表示迁移（Global Body Representation Transfer）训练视频骨干网络预测完整人体渲染结果，将其原本的预测任务转变为学习表面对应关系与姿态几何的手段。局部关节特征增强（Local Joint Feature Enhancement）将上下文估计与可靠的局部证据相结合，以恢复精细的身体与手部细节，同时限制遮挡物与背景的干扰。在五个数据集、四种视频骨干网络上的实验表明，该方法在多个骨干网络系列上均具有强大的重建性能。在统一评估协议下，我们的最佳模型在 3DPW、EMDB-1 和 RICH 的所有报告指标上均优于现有最佳方法，身体 MPJPE 分别降低 4.2%、4.7% 和 6.1%。在留出的 BEDLAM 与 EgoBody 序列上更具挑战性的遮挡设置中，DreamHMR 将整体身体与手部 MPJPE 分别降低 7.0% 和 10.0%。我们的代码将公开提供。

title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
summary: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

AI.title_zh: RepForcing：面向自回归视频蒸馏的表征空间初始化
AI.abstract_zh: 将预训练视频扩散模型蒸馏为少步自回归（AR）生成器，通常将学生模型初始化与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）相结合。一个中间 AR 教师可以为 ODE 初始化提供因果兼容的目标。然而，仅有因果兼容的目标并不能保证在短采样调度下获得高质量生成。我们分析了直接潜变量回归所偏好的后验均值预测，并经验性地发现因果 ODE 初始化缓解了模糊，但仍未能解决精细细节。为解决这一局限，我们提出 Representation Forcing，它通过表征空间监督而非中间教师轨迹回归来学习少步因果初始化。学生模型以教师强制方式训练，通过一个冻结视频扩散 transformer 的归一化特征来比较干净预测与训练目标。该阶段复用了由双向模型生成的合成视频用于 AR 教师训练，并替代了教师训练与因果 ODE 蒸馏，且无需生成额外的因果 ODE 轨迹。随后的非对称 DMD 流程保持不变。实证结果表明，在四步采样下，RepForcing 在 DMD 之前比基于中间教师的初始化更好地保持了生成质量。在 DMD 之后，我们的四步分块模型相较于所报告的基于因果 ODE 的基线，将 VBench Total 从 84.04 提升至 84.66（+0.62 分），将 VisionReward 从 6.326 提升至 10.074（+59.25%）。

title: When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO
summary: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

AI.title_zh: 当成对偏好出现循环时：一种用于视频 GRPO 的可靠性锚定偏好游走
AI.abstract_zh: 成对偏好反馈已成为视频生成模型强化学习中广泛采用的监督信号，因为在评估生成视频的质量时，成对比较比逐点标量评分提供了更可靠的替代方案。具体而言，我们在成对评估器下为每个 GRPO 组定义了一个偏好图，其中节点表示采样的 rollout，边编码成对偏好。通过审计 6,976 个同策略比较图，我们发现循环偏好普遍存在，并在整个训练过程中持续存在。基于平均胜率的朴素成对奖励聚合丢弃了底层的比较结构，并将每个 rollout 独立对待，这可能为某些 rollout 引入不可靠的优势估计，进而影响强化学习优化。因此，我们提出了 \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk}（\ours{}），一种图感知的优势聚合方法，它通过可靠性引导的偏好游走，用来自循环偏好图的可靠关系证据来增强来自胜率的全局偏好信号。在匹配评估器、比较协议、组大小、提示调度和查询预算的条件下，\ours{} 除每个 rollout 组内已观测到的比较之外不需要额外的评估器查询，并在受控比较、迁移设置和盲人人类评估中优于 Pairwise-GRPO。

title: Neurosymbolic Learning of Interpretable World Models
summary: World models aim to learn compact representations of an environment from observations, enabling agents to predict future states and plan their behaviour. However, most existing approaches learn black-box representations, with limited ability to incorporate prior knowledge about the world. We introduce Concept-Grounded World Models (CGWMs), a neurosymbolic world model design that instead learns interpretable concept representations. We learn these concepts from observations using explicit and complete knowledge, expressed in temporal logic, that specifies the valid world states and the temporal relations governing their dynamics. Furthermore, we directly use this knowledge by formulating planning as differentiable reasoning, optimising the agent's actions by gradient ascent to satisfy a goal. We experimentally compare CGWM with a purely neural baseline and a neurosymbolic baseline on two game environments. We find that CGWMs ground concepts much more accurately, even over long horizons, resulting in significantly more robust planning both in and out of distribution.

AI.title_zh: 可解释世界模型的神经符号学习
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型旨在从观测中学习环境的紧凑表示，使智能体能够预测未来状态并规划其行为。然而，大多数现有方法学习的是黑箱表示，融入关于世界的先验知识的能力有限。我们提出了概念接地世界模型（Concept-Grounded World Models, CGWMs），这是一种神经符号世界模型设计，转而学习可解释的概念表示。我们使用以时序逻辑表达的显式且完整的知识，从观测中学习这些概念，该知识规定了有效的世界状态以及支配其动态的时序关系。此外，我们通过将规划形式化为可微推理来直接使用这一知识，通过梯度上升优化智能体的动作以满足目标。我们在两个游戏环境中将 CGWM 与纯神经基线和神经符号基线进行了实验比较。我们发现，CGWM 对概念进行接地的准确性要高得多，即使在长时程上也是如此，从而在分布内和分布外都带来了显著更稳健的规划。

title: What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?
summary: Integrating world models into Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) has emerged as a promising direction, enabling policies to anticipate future dynamics beyond reactive observation-to-action mapping. However, existing approaches vary simultaneously in their world representations, integration paradigms, and policy backbones, making it difficult to determine what truly matters for effective world model integration. To disentangle these factors, we categorize existing efforts into four representative paradigms, namely Implicit Future Alignment, Explicit Future Query, MoT Future Expert, and External World Predictor. We instantiate each within a unified framework and systematically evaluate these paradigms with diverse world representations and policy backbones across in-domain, out-of-domain, long-horizon, dynamic, few-shot, and real-world settings. Our study yields four main findings: 1) world representation effectiveness is paradigm-dependent, whereas 2D semantic representations offer robust, cross-paradigm gains; 2) no single paradigm is universally optimal, yet the decoupled MoT Future Expert offers competitive overall performance, particularly in OOD robustness; 3) world modeling consistently benefits policies built on standard VLMs, while decoupled designs exhibit greater compatibility with pretrained VLAs; and 4) world modeling improves performance over action-only baselines across multiple settings, with notable gains on long-horizon and dynamic tasks. Project page and video demonstrations are available at https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/.

AI.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型中的世界建模：什么才是关键？
AI.abstract_zh: 将世界模型集成到视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action models，VLAs）中已成为一个有前景的方向，使策略能够超越反应式的“观测到动作”映射，预测未来动态。然而，现有方法在世界表示、集成范式和策略骨干网络方面同时存在差异，使得难以确定对于有效的世界模型集成而言，什么才是真正关键的。为了厘清这些因素，我们将现有工作归类为四种代表性范式，即隐式未来对齐（Implicit Future Alignment）、显式未来查询（Explicit Future Query）、MoT 未来专家（MoT Future Expert）和外部世界预测器（External World Predictor）。我们在一个统一框架内实例化每一种范式，并在域内、域外、长时程、动态、少样本以及真实世界设置中，使用多样的世界表示和策略骨干网络对这些范式进行系统评估。我们的研究得出四项主要发现：1）世界表示的有效性依赖于范式，而 2D 语义表示能够带来稳健的、跨范式的增益；2）没有哪一种范式具有普遍最优性，但解耦的 MoT 未来专家（MoT Future Expert）提供了有竞争力的整体性能，尤其是在 OOD 鲁棒性方面；3）世界建模始终能使基于标准 VLM 构建的策略受益，而解耦设计则与预训练 VLA 展现出更强的兼容性；4）世界建模在多种设置中相较仅动作基线提升了性能，并在长时程和动态任务上取得显著增益。项目页面和视频演示见 https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/。

title: PhyMetric: Diagnosing Physical Plausibility in Text-to-Video Generation via Scene-Level QA
comment: This work is accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce visually realistic videos that nevertheless violate the physical consequences implied by the prompt and scene. Existing benchmarks largely rely on holistic plausibility scores or broad quality dimensions, leaving it unclear which physical behavior is being tested and why a model fails. We introduce PhyMetric, a scene-level diagnostic benchmark that recasts physical plausibility evaluation as verifiable, scene-grounded question answering. PhyMetric contains 1{,}115 scenes spanning 50 physical categories across six domains, paired with 8{,}920 answer-balanced binary questions over 12 evaluation dimensions. Each scene is associated with eight targeted yes/no questions and a structured physical prior specifying the governing law, expected temporal sequence, observable signatures, and common failure modes. At evaluation time, a vision-language model (VLM) judge answers each question from question-aware sampled frames conditioned on the prior, and correctness is hierarchically aggregated into scene, dimension, physical category, and model scores. Experiments on four open-source T2V models and three VLM judges show that scene-specific binary QA is a critical component of the protocol: when each targeted question is replaced by a single generic plausibility query, evaluator accuracy drops to the chance level. Structured physical priors offer a complementary signal that improves human alignment of the resulting scores, with effects that vary across VLM judges of different capacity. These findings establish PhyMetric as a benchmark that turns physical plausibility evaluation from opaque holistic scoring into interpretable, scene-level inspection. Our project page is available at: https://mengsiwei.github.io/PhyMetric/.

AI.title_zh: PhyMetric：通过场景级问答诊断文本到视频生成中的物理合理性
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频（T2V）生成模型能够生成视觉上逼真的视频，但这些视频却可能违反提示与场景所蕴含的物理后果。现有基准在很大程度上依赖于整体合理性分数或宽泛的质量维度，从而使得人们不清楚正在测试的是哪一种物理行为，以及模型为何失败。我们提出 PhyMetric，一个场景级诊断基准，将物理合理性评估重新表述为可验证的、以场景为依据的问答。PhyMetric 包含跨越六个领域、50 个物理类别的 1{,}115 个场景，并配有覆盖 12 个评估维度的 8{,}920 个答案平衡的二元问题。每个场景关联八个有针对性的是/否问题，以及一个结构化物理先验，该先验规定支配定律、预期时间序列、可观测特征和常见失败模式。在评估时，一个视觉语言模型（VLM）评判者基于该先验，从问题感知采样的帧中回答每个问题，正确性被分层聚合为场景、维度、物理类别和模型分数。对四个开源 T2V 模型和三个 VLM 评判者的实验表明，场景特定的二元问答是该协议的关键组成部分：当每个有针对性的问题被替换为单个通用合理性查询时，评估者准确率降至随机水平。结构化物理先验提供了一种互补信号，可提升所得分数与人类判断的一致性，其效果在不同能力的 VLM 评判者之间有所差异。这些发现确立了 PhyMetric 作为一个基准的地位，它把物理合理性评估从不透明的整体评分转变为可解释的场景级检查。我们的项目页面见：https://mengsiwei.github.io/PhyMetric/。

title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
summary: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.

AI.title_zh: StateCraft：以抽象状态推理增强视频世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型旨在以逼真的外观与动态来模拟复杂环境。要在长程交互中保持一致性，就需要追踪过去的动作并理解这些动作如何影响环境。视频世界模型一次只能生成对整个世界的部分观测。仅记住过去的观测在每个场景中可能并不足够，因为在经历一系列动作之后，它们可能已不再反映世界的状态。我们提出一种范式，将持久、可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦。抽象状态随着世界演化追踪实体的变化，并被用于对表示当前视图的视觉状态进行条件化。我们提出 StateCraft，这是一种将语言模型与视频扩散模型配对以演化动态世界的新架构。我们在生成式界面（generative interfaces）上评估我们的方法，这类界面构成重大挑战，因为单个动作可能改变当前不可见的部分状态。为支持训练与评估，我们开发了一条数据收集流水线，可在无需人工或智能体监督的情况下大规模生成信息丰富、密集标注的轨迹，并构建了一个衡量生成质量、记忆与可控性的基准。在该基准上，我们的方法超越了最先进的基线。我们证明 StateCraft 在长轨迹上保持高自一致性与强生成质量。由于抽象状态是显式的，它可以直接被编辑，并且生成会遵循对数据中从未观测到的状态的编辑。最后，一个概念验证性的 3D 实验——其中动作改变了未观测房间的照明——表明该范式也可应用于空间环境。项目页面：https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/。

title: Recognizing Dialogue Ambiguity via Candidate Set Visual Grounding
summary: Interpreting an ambiguous utterance in real-world interactions often requires context beyond a single utterance. When the utterance refers to objects in a visual scene, it is necessary to maintain and update the set of plausible referents as context accumulates, without assuming that the available information identifies a unique object. However, prior work on interactive visual grounding, which localizes objects referred to by linguistic expressions, has focused on identifying a unique object once sufficient dialogue context becomes available. To address this gap, we propose Candidate Set Visual Grounding (CSVG), a task for estimating the set of objects consistent with the given dialogue context. We further introduce CandVG, a benchmark that evaluates how the candidate set changes across dialogue turns. Our evaluation of vision-language models shows that stronger visual grounding capability does not necessarily yield better CSVG performance. In particular, models have difficulty predicting the complete candidate set, owing to challenges in candidate generation and premature commitment to a small set of candidates in early turns. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation can be partially mitigated in the evaluated large-scale models using instructions designed for CSVG.

AI.title_zh: 通过候选集视觉定位识别对话歧义
AI.abstract_zh: 在现实世界交互中，理解一句有歧义的话语往往需要超越单句话语的上下文。当该话语指涉视觉场景中的物体时，有必要随着上下文的累积维持并更新可能指称对象的集合，而不能假设已有信息能够唯一确定某个物体。然而，以往关于交互式视觉定位（即定位语言表达所指涉的物体）的工作，主要关注在获得充分的对话上下文后识别出唯一的物体。为弥补这一空白，我们提出候选集视觉定位（Candidate Set Visual Grounding, CSVG），这是一项用于估计与给定对话上下文相一致的物体集合的任务。我们进一步提出 CandVG，一个评估候选集如何随对话轮次变化的基准。我们对视觉语言模型的评估表明，更强的视觉定位能力并不必然带来更好的 CSVG 性能。尤其是，由于在候选生成方面存在困难，以及在早期轮次中过早地锁定于一小部分候选对象，模型难以预测完整的候选集。尽管如此，我们发现，在所评估的大规模模型中，使用为 CSVG 设计的指令可以部分缓解这一局限。

title: SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space
summary: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory. For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.

AI.title_zh: SceneAE：在可查询的3D锚定潜空间中进行场景生成与重建
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的视频世界模型越来越多地采用3D记忆机制，将历史观测整合为一种轻量且持久的场景表示。这自然引出一个互补的问题：如果3D表示能够作为一种有效机制来记忆已观测的场景，那么它们是否也能直接用作重建和生成场景的潜空间？受这一想法启发，我们将场景表示为一个紧凑且非结构化的3D锚定潜空间（\textbf{SceneAE}）。每个潜变量将显式的3D位置与隐式的内容特征相结合，并在空间上被锚定以描述其局部场景区域，从而形成一个稀疏的潜点云。与描述场景从特定视角如何呈现的传统视频VAE潜变量不同，我们的表示直接描述场景本身，使其自然适用于重建和生成这两项任务。对于重建，一旦场景被生成，我们的持久3D表示即可由不同的目标相机投影并解码为RGB-D观测，而无需为每条新的相机轨迹重新生成视频。对于生成，我们利用几何与内容的分离，先生成相机控制的3D几何，再以之为条件合成内容，从而减少相机与外观的纠缠并提升相机可控性。实验表明，该3D潜变量在生成质量、计算成本和相机可控性方面均取得了更优表现。

title: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
summary: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

AI.title_zh: 用联想记忆增强潜在世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 通过潜在动力学训练的世界模型为具身规划提供了一条可扩展的路径，然而现有方法存在表征坍塌、计算开销以及长时程能力有限的问题。我们引入一种记忆增强的潜在世界模型，它以内容可寻址的记忆库增强 JEPA 风格的预测。我们的方法直接从观测中学习高层表征，在共享潜在空间内的多个时间尺度上运行，并通过自适应层归一化来调节预测条件。为防止坍塌并确保有效的记忆使用，我们设计了两个互补的损失，以鼓励槽位多样性（slot diversity）和平衡的时间利用率。在 PushT、Tworoom、Reacher 和 OGBCube 上的实验表明，我们的方法以轻量级架构实现了最先进的性能，在长时程规划任务上优于传统的潜在世界模型。

title: Remember, Revisit, Revise: Scaffold Memory for Long-Horizon 3D Geometry
summary: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.

AI.title_zh: 记住、重访、修正：面向长时程三维几何的脚手架记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型从视频序列中估计相机位姿与三维场景结构，但在长时程上保持一致的 reconstruction 仍然具有挑战性。前馈模型将长序列作为独立的、固定长度的帧窗口进行处理并对其预测进行对齐，导致位姿与重建误差在窗口之间累积。流式模型保留过去帧的信息以指导未来预测，但当后续观测揭示出错误时无法修正此前的估计。为解决这一问题，我们提出了面向修正的脚手架记忆（Scaffold MemOry for Revision, SMORE），这是一个为冻结的几何基础模型配备可修正外部记忆以进行长时程推理的框架。受生物大脑中海马体联想记忆的启发——其将空间情境与感官经验相联结——SMORE 将观察者所处位置与其所观察到的事物相关联，使过去的观测能够被存储、检索、依据新证据进行验证，并在检测到不一致时被修正。我们在涵盖相机位姿估计、多视图深度估计、三维点云重建、同步定位与建图（SLAM）以及新视图合成的五个数据集上，用八个具有竞争力的几何模型评估了 SMORE。在所有被评估的模型中，SMORE 一致地改善了长序列位姿估计，将多视图深度误差最多降低 58%，将三维点云重建的 Chamfer 距离最多降低 43%，并在长时程 SLAM 中实现低至 2.9 cm 的平均轨迹误差。通过保留修正后的位姿与观测，SMORE 进一步提升了大规模三维场景重建的保真度与空间一致性。这些结果确立了可修正外部记忆作为一种灵活接口，可将预训练几何模型拓展至超出固定上下文预测的范围，实现对长视觉序列的迭代式、误差修正推理。

title: Back on Track: Deployment-time Policy Improvement via World Model Planning
summary: State-of-the-art visuomotor policies are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks, yet can fail during deployment in ways they cannot predict or recover from on their own. Improving their performance and robustness typically requires collecting more data, retraining, or modifying the policy architecture, all of which are time- and resource-intensive in practice. We instead propose an offline-trained monitoring-and-intervention framework that improves a policy during deployment using only black-box query access. From a limited set of labeled on-policy rollouts, we learn a policy-conditioned liveness value that measures the nominal policy's progress toward task completion; we additionally train a compact latent world model using these rollouts together with play data. At deployment, the liveness value continuously monitors execution. When it detects a loss of progress, a short-horizon planner searches the world model for corrective actions using the same value as its planning objective, after which control returns to the nominal policy. We evaluate our method on the LIBERO-Goal task suite and on a Franka Panda manipulator, using the vision-language-action model $π_{0.5}$ and a diffusion policy as nominal policies, and demonstrate significant improvements in task success rates, while supporting real-time control. Additional results and videos are available on the project website (https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/).

AI.title_zh: 重回正轨：通过世界模型规划在部署时改进策略
AI.abstract_zh: 最先进的视觉运动策略（visuomotor policy）在执行复杂任务方面日益强大，但在部署期间仍可能以自身无法预测或恢复的方式失败。要提升其性能与鲁棒性，通常需要收集更多数据、重新训练或修改策略架构，而这些在实践中都耗时耗资源。我们转而提出一个离线训练的监控与干预框架，仅使用黑盒查询访问，即可在部署期间改进策略。我们从一组有限的带标注的在线策略（on-policy）rollout 中，学习一个以策略为条件的存活值（liveness value），用以衡量名义策略（nominal policy）在任务完成上的进展；此外，我们利用这些 rollout 连同 play data 训练一个紧凑的潜在世界模型。在部署时，存活值持续监控执行过程。当它检测到进展丧失时，一个短时域规划器使用同一价值作为其规划目标，在世界模型中搜索纠正动作，之后控制权交还给名义策略。我们在 LIBERO-Goal 任务套件以及 Franka Panda 机械臂上进行评估，使用视觉-语言-动作模型 $\pi_{0.5}$ 和扩散策略（diffusion policy）作为名义策略，并证明任务成功率获得显著提升，同时支持实时控制。更多结果与视频见项目网站（https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/）。

title: Frame Evidence:A Benchmark for Reference Frames and Visual Evidence in Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning
summary: A spatial answer depends on the reference frame specified in language and its supporting visual evidence. Item accuracy alone obscures whether correctness persists when either changes. We introduce Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions from captured and rendered scenes. One family compares three grounded reference frames over fixed images. The other pairs image deletion annotated as insufficient with answer-preserving addition. Joint metrics require correct answers across all three frames and paired evidence variants. Across 20 configurations on 288 held-out questions, GPT three-shot reaches 50.00\% item accuracy, but the best three-frame group accuracy is 5/48 (10.42\%), reached by GPT two-shot. Few-shot prompting and task-specific adaptation improve item accuracy without consistently improving joint correctness. Input controls show where images support matched success, while repeated executions reveal answer instability beneath similar scores.

AI.title_zh: 框架证据：多图像空间推理中参考框架与视觉证据的基准
AI.abstract_zh: 空间答案取决于语言中指定的参考框架及其支撑性视觉证据。仅凭单题准确率无法揭示当二者之一发生变化时正确性是否仍然保持。我们提出 Frame Evidence，一个包含 320 个匹配三元组和 960 道中文多项选择题的基准，题目来自实拍与渲染场景。其中一个问题族在固定图像上比较三种有依据的参考框架。另一个问题族将标注为证据不足的图像删除与保持答案不变的新增图像配对。联合指标要求在所有三种参考框架以及成对证据变体上均给出正确答案。在 288 道留出问题上的 20 种配置中，GPT 三样本（three-shot）达到 50.00\% 的单题准确率，但最佳的三框架组准确率为 5/48（10.42\%），由 GPT 两样本（two-shot）达到。少样本提示与任务特定适配提升了单题准确率，却未持续提升联合正确性。输入控制实验显示了图像在何处支持匹配成功，而重复执行则揭示了相似分数之下存在的答案不稳定性。

title: Spectral World Renderer: Unified 3D Hyperspectral Unmixing
summary: Cameras and the foundation models built on them recognize what a 3D scene contains, but not what it is made of: surfaces of the same colour can be different materials. Hyperspectral unmixing explains each spectrum as a mixture of material signatures, yet in 3D it is applied to rendered images after the views are composited, or tied to slow implicit fields, and no multi-view data with known composition exist to check the result. We present the Spectral World Renderer (SWR), which unifies world generation and unmixing. A coding agent builds executable 3D worlds that are rendered with measured spectra, so every hyperspectral image comes with exact labels and sub-pixel proportions; the resulting SWR-Bench provides eight indoor and outdoor worlds in which decompositions can be verified. SWR then unmixes inside rendering: each Gaussian of a compact 3D representation is decoded into material abundances before compositing, so one render yields spectra and material maps, and any surface can be queried by material name, a clicked pixel or a reference spectrum. Without material labels, SWR identifies materials best in all eight worlds, has the best mean PSNR on real captures, trains 3.7-12.9x faster than unmixing baselines, renders 34.9 labelled views/s and separates same-coloured materials.

AI.title_zh: 光谱世界渲染器：统一的三维高光谱解混
AI.abstract_zh: 相机以及建立在其上的基础模型能识别三维场景中包含什么，却不能识别它由什么构成：颜色相同的表面可能是不同的材料。高光谱解混将每个光谱解释为材料特征的混合，但在三维中，它要么在视图合成之后被应用于渲染图像，要么被绑定到缓慢的隐式场上，并且不存在具有已知组成成分的多视图数据来检验结果。我们提出光谱世界渲染器（Spectral World Renderer，SWR），它将世界生成与解混统一起来。一个编码智能体构建可用测量光谱渲染的可执行三维世界，因此每幅高光谱图像都附带精确标签和亚像素比例；由此得到的 SWR-Bench 提供八个室内与室外世界，其中的分解结果可以被验证。SWR 随后在渲染内部进行解混：紧凑三维表示的每个高斯在合成之前被解码为材料丰度，因此一次渲染即产生光谱和材料图，并且任何表面都可以通过材料名称、点击的像素或参考光谱进行查询。在没有材料标签的情况下，SWR 在全部八个世界中材料识别效果最佳，在真实拍摄数据上具有最佳平均 PSNR，训练速度比解混基线快 3.7-12.9 倍，渲染速度为每秒 34.9 个带标签视图，并能区分颜色相同的材料。

title: Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.

AI.title_zh: Holi-Spatial 360：面向空间渲染与智能的稀疏全景图生成式重建
AI.abstract_zh: 空间智能需要既具备照片级真实感又具有语义基础的可扩展三维环境，然而现有室内数据集以房间尺度的采集和昂贵的 LiDAR 获取为主。在线房地产平台提供了大量多样化的多房间住宅全景图，但稀疏的视点和缺乏纹理的区域使重建严重欠约束。我们提出 Holi-Spatial 360，这是一个生成式重建与数据整理框架，用于将这些全景图转换为带标注的多房间三维环境。由于重建质量限制了后续生成，我们的对应引导几何优化（Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization）将前馈重建先验转化为可靠的跨视图约束，并构建一致的三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示作为三维空间记忆。随后，经适配的单图像和视频先验在保留已观测内容的同时恢复外观并补全连续轨迹。重建出的场景支持任意 RGB-D 渲染，以及一个将端到端三维定位（3D grounding）与基于 VLM 的验证相结合的自动化整理流程。Holi360 包含超过 1K 个多房间 3DGS 场景、超过 100K 个实例标注以及 2M 个空间问答对。我们还引入 Holi360 基准，用于评估 VLM 在真实世界多房间室内环境中的空间理解能力。实验表明，在稀疏全景输入下，重建与整理质量更优，同时在 Holi360 上微调 VLM 可显著提升空间推理能力。

title: More Than Seeing: Vision as Scalable Anchors in Native Multimodal Pre-Training
summary: Native multimodal pre-training trains a single model from scratch on text and multimodal data, enabling it to understand both language and visual inputs. However, how visual signals shape scaling behavior and support capabilities beyond visual understanding remains unclear. We investigate this question through controlled visual-content ablations across model sizes and training budgets. Specifically, we replace image embeddings with content-free padding token embeddings. Retaining visual content improves text prediction on image-text examples without materially changing the lowest text-only loss at a given compute budget, the optimal balance of model size and training data, or aggregate language scores. The relative multimodal loss benefit grows approximately as a power law of compute. To test benefits beyond understanding images, we evaluate spatial reasoning from text descriptions alone. Both conditions improve with model and data scaling. During training of the largest model, visual gains are most sustained in localization, navigation, and symbolic planning, which involve maintaining object configurations or composing spatial updates; gains in spatial relations, geometry, and physical commonsense are less consistent. These findings identify visual content as a scalable anchor for multimodal learning, with benefits that extend beyond visual inputs while preserving aggregate language performance.

AI.title_zh: 不止于看：视觉作为原生多模态预训练中的可扩展锚点
AI.abstract_zh: 原生多模态预训练（Native multimodal pre-training）在文本和多模态数据上从零开始训练单一模型，使其能够理解语言和视觉输入。然而，视觉信号如何塑造扩展行为、以及如何支撑超越视觉理解的能力，仍不清楚。我们通过在不同模型规模和训练预算下进行的受控视觉内容消融实验来研究这一问题。具体而言，我们用无内容的填充词元嵌入（padding token embeddings）替换图像嵌入。保留视觉内容能够改善图像-文本样本上的文本预测，而在给定计算预算下，不会实质性改变最低的纯文本损失、模型规模与训练数据的最优平衡，或聚合语言得分。多模态损失的相对收益大约随计算量呈幂律增长。为检验超越理解图像的收益，我们仅从文本描述评估空间推理。两种条件均随模型和数据规模的扩展而改善。在最大模型的训练过程中，视觉带来的收益在定位、导航和符号规划方面最为持久，这些任务涉及维持物体配置或组合空间更新；而在空间关系、几何和物理常识方面的收益则不太一致。这些发现将视觉内容识别为多模态学习的可扩展锚点，其收益超越视觉输入，同时保持聚合语言性能。

title: Integrating Simulation and Chain-of-thought Reasoning in Multimodal-Language Models For Physical Reasoning
summary: Multimodal language models often need to reason about the physical dynamics of the world in order to answer questions appropriately. Various methods have emerged for solving physical reasoning tasks, and in particular, two leading approaches are Chain-of-Thought reasoning and physics-grounded simulation. However, relatively little is known about which particular problems can be solved by each approach. Some tasks may benefit from computationally expensive generative video simulations, whereas others may be solved equally well (or even better) with language-based reasoning. Our work addresses this by systematically comparing simulation and language reasoning across a variety of multimodal tasks involving physical reasoning, such as answering questions about fluid dynamics and elasticity. We draw a parallel with this to resource-rational theories of human cognition, which propose that people optimally trade off simulation and reasoning depending on task demands. We present a novel cognitively-inspired hybrid model which optimally trades off simulation and reasoning to improve model performance and computational efficiency. Our model is able to decide the appropriate method to solve a physical reasoning problem at test time, and finds an optimal balance between accuracy and cost. Further, our model can be trained on a smaller vision-language model that is only 4B parameters and deployed to improve performance on much bigger base models with $>$3T parameters like Gemini 3 Pro.

AI.title_zh: 在多模态语言模型中将模拟与思维链推理相结合以进行物理推理
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型常常需要对世界的物理动力学进行推理，才能恰当地回答问题。解决物理推理任务的方法已出现多种，尤其是两种主流方法：思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理与基于物理的模拟（physics-grounded simulation）。然而，对于这两种方法各自能解决哪些具体问题，人们所知相对较少。有些任务可能受益于计算代价高昂的生成式视频模拟，而另一些任务用基于语言的推理也能同样好地（甚至更好地）解决。我们的工作通过在多类涉及物理推理的多模态任务（例如回答关于流体动力学和弹性的问题）上系统地比较模拟与语言推理，来应对这一问题。我们将其与人类认知的资源理性（resource-rational）理论相类比，该理论提出人们会根据任务需求在模拟与推理之间进行最优权衡。我们提出了一种受认知启发的新型混合模型，它在模拟与推理之间进行最优权衡，以提升模型性能与计算效率。我们的模型能够在测试时决定用何种合适的方法来解决一个物理推理问题，并在准确率与成本之间找到最优平衡。此外，我们的模型可以在一个仅 4B 参数的较小视觉-语言模型上训练，并部署用于提升大得多的基础模型（如 Gemini 3 Pro 等 $>$3T 参数的模型）的性能。

title: One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI (WM-PAI)
summary: Latent world models are routinely selected, checkpointed and ablated on one-step prediction loss, on the assumption that a model which predicts the next latent better is a better model. In model-based RL this assumption is known to be unreliable; we ask whether it also fails for latent world models, where the training target is the model's own embedding and the loss is not expressed in interpretable units. We introduce a frozen-decoder protocol reporting one-step error in physical units, decomposed into the part already present in the encoder's representation and the part the predictor adds. Applying it to a recent end-to-end JEPA world model across three continuous-control environments, we move the metric by fine-tuning and measure goal-conditioned planning on the same checkpoints, with three training seeds and paired planning seeds throughout. Within one environment, a per-epoch ladder shows the relationship saturating after a single epoch: the first epoch improves fidelity by 32% and planning by 4.4 pp, but across the fifteen checkpoints that follow -- a further 15% fidelity improvement, monotone in every training seed -- the correlation between one-step error and planning success is r = -0.010. This is not a task-ceiling artifact: stratifying by a model-independent measure of training-data support, planning in the lowest-support stratum starts at 80%, leaving ample headroom, and is nonetheless flat from epoch 1 onward. Across environments the exchange rate is equally unstable: a 93% fidelity reduction on TwoRoom yields -0.7 pp of planning, while a 40% reduction on PushT yields +4.9 pp [+1.1, +8.9]. All results replicate under a decoder-free measure, latent drift. We also show that a matched continued-training control absorbs the entire fidelity gain we had attributed to an auxiliary objective.

AI.title_zh: 单步预测保真度是 JEPA 世界模型中规划性能的不良替代指标
AI.abstract_zh: 潜空间世界模型通常依据单步预测损失来进行选择、保存检查点与消融，其假设是：能更好地预测下一潜变量的模型就是更好的模型。在基于模型的强化学习中，这一假设已知并不可靠；我们追问它对于潜空间世界模型是否同样失效——在这类模型中，训练目标是模型自身的嵌入，且损失不以可解释的单位表示。我们提出一种冻结解码器协议，以物理单位报告单步误差，并将其分解为编码器表示中已有的部分与预测器所新增的部分。将其应用于一个近期的端到端 JEPA 世界模型，在三个连续控制环境中，我们通过微调来推动该指标变化，并在相同的检查点上测量目标条件规划，全程使用三个训练种子与配对的规划种子。在单一环境内，逐epoch阶梯显示该关系在单个epoch之后即饱和：第一个epoch将保真度提升32%、规划提升4.4个百分点，但在随后的十五个检查点上——保真度进一步提升15%，且在每一个训练种子中都是单调的——单步误差与规划成功率之间的相关性为 r = -0.010。这不是任务天花板造成的假象：按一种与模型无关的训练数据支持度度量进行分层后，最低支持度层中的规划从80%起步，仍有充足提升空间，却自epoch 1起就持平。跨环境时，这种兑换率同样不稳定：TwoRoom上93%的保真度下降仅带来-0.7个百分点的规划变化，而PushT上40%的下降则带来+4.9个百分点 [+1.1, +8.9]。所有结果在一种无需解码器的度量——潜变量漂移——下均可复现。我们还表明，一个匹配的持续训练对照吸收了此前我们归因于某项辅助目标的全部保真度增益。

title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
summary: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

AI.title_zh: SonoWorld：迈向交互式位姿可控的超声世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人超声可以标准化图像采集，并降低操作者工作负荷与变异性，但策略学习仍然受限于缺乏真实、可控的仿真环境。尽管可控世界模型在自然图像领域发展迅速，超声世界建模仍然具有挑战性，因为每一帧仅捕捉未观测到的三维解剖结构的一个截面，导致探头的小幅运动即可引起较大的外观变化。现有方法依赖机器人跟踪位姿和潜在空间预测，但并不直接生成交互式控制所需的观测。我们提出 SonoWorld，一种因果超声世界模型，它从无标注临床视频中学习视频动力学，并利用一小组由电磁（EM）传感器跟踪的徒手临床扫描将其与 6 自由度控制相关联。SonoWorld 分三阶段训练：在约 690 万帧无标注多器官超声帧上预训练一个以潜在动作为条件的视频扩散模型；利用一个规模较小的 EM 跟踪甲状腺数据集，将学到的视频动力学与度量探头位姿对齐；并应用分布匹配蒸馏，以在推理时通过选择性缓存驱逐 token，实现因果、长时程自回归生成。我们在留出的跟踪扫描上，通过合成动作下的位姿跟随保真度、往返一致性和轴特定控制来评估可控性，并进一步通过用户研究进行验证。在基于模型的动作判别中，SonoWorld 在最多 74.8% 的试验中能将目标导向的探头运动正确排在同幅度相反运动之上。据我们所知，SonoWorld 是首个主要从徒手临床视频中学习得到的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型，为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供了数据驱动的交互式环境。

title: Kandinsky S2V 1.0: Audio-Driven Avatar Video Generation
comment: Technical report on the open-source S2V model
summary: We present Kandinsky S2V 1.0, an open family of speech-to-video models for controllable audio-driven human animation, comprising Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite (2B parameters) and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro (21B parameters). From a single reference image, a speech waveform, and a text prompt, the models generate long-form 25 FPS video in which lip motion, expression, pose, and gesture follow the speech. The architecture draws text and audio conditioning from one Qwen2.5-Omni model and adds a reference-aware three-scale visual memory. Training starts from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video foundation models [1] and combines mixed reference-memory layouts with an area-adaptive face loss. The training corpus contains 1.17M single-speaker clips selected by active-speaker detection, with captions generated directly in English and Russian. A side-by-side human evaluation against the strongest open-source baseline and two proprietary commercial models shows that Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro performs comparably to or better than these models on average and is also preferred for lip synchronization. On common speech to video benchmarks, Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro rank among the top performing models according to mean rank over five reported metrics. Beyond the base models, we provide π-Flow distilled variants of both Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro. The distilled Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro model generates video in 16 sampling steps without classifier-free guidance, achieving a 5.4 times end-to-end speedup over the base model, while matching or exceeding it on nearly all reported benchmark metrics. To accelerate open research and deployment in speech-to-video generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

AI.title_zh: Kandinsky S2V 1.0：音频驱动数字人视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Kandinsky S2V 1.0，这是一个用于可控音频驱动人物动画的开放语音到视频（speech-to-video）模型系列，包含 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite（2B 参数）与 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro（21B 参数）。给定单张参考图像、一段语音波形和一个文本提示，这些模型可生成 25 FPS 的长视频，其中唇部运动、表情、姿态和手势均跟随语音。该架构从同一个 Qwen2.5-Omni 模型中获取文本和音频条件，并加入参考感知的三尺度视觉记忆。训练从 Kandinsky 5.0 Video 基础模型 [1] 出发，并结合混合参考-记忆布局与面积自适应人脸损失。训练语料包含 1.17M 个通过主动说话人检测筛选出的单说话人片段，其字幕直接以英语和俄语生成。与最强的开源基线以及两个专有商业模型进行的并排人工评估表明，Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 的平均表现与这些模型相当或更好，并且在唇同步方面也更受偏好。在常见的语音到视频基准上，依据五项所报告指标的均值排名，Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite 和 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 位列表现最佳的模型之中。除基础模型外，我们还提供了 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite 和 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 的 π-Flow 蒸馏变体。蒸馏后的 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 模型在无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）的情况下以 16 个采样步骤生成视频，相较于基础模型实现 5.4 倍的端到端加速，同时在几乎所有所报告的基准指标上达到或超过基础模型。为加速语音到视频生成的开放研究与部署，我们以 MIT 许可证发布代码、模型检查点和 diffusers 集成。

title: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://eren-cetin.github.io/SMART/
summary: Memory for long-horizon video generation must satisfy two competing requirements: it must remain bounded so generation can continue indefinitely, while still recovering what was observed at a place when the camera returns, regardless of how long ago it was seen. Reconstruction-based memories provide spatial recall by caching and reprojecting explicit geometry, but require growing storage and depend on estimated 3D structure. Recurrent memories keep a constant-size state, but retention is governed by temporal recurrence, causing old observations to fade with time. We introduce SMART, a slot memory addressed by region tokens, which combines bounded storage with spatially addressed recall. SMART stores content in a constant-size slot recurrence whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, without constructing an explicit 3D representation or maintaining a growing cache. Consequently, recall is conditioned on inter-view geometry rather than on recency.
