Each read additionally provides a confidence estimate that conditions a chunk-causal diffusion transformer, allowing it to selectively trust retrieved content while relying on its generative prior elsewhere. On long trajectories in Memory Maze and Minecraft, SMART maintains high-fidelity recall far beyond its training horizon while using constant memory and per-step cost.

AI.title_zh: 基于区域令牌寻址的槽记忆长时域视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 长时域视频生成的记忆必须满足两项相互竞争的要求：它必须保持有界，以便生成可以无限持续；同时仍能在相机返回某处时恢复该处曾观测到的内容，无论该内容是在多久之前被看到的。基于重建的记忆通过缓存并重投影显式几何来提供空间回忆，但需要不断增长的存储，并依赖于估计的 3D 结构。循环记忆保持恒定大小的状态，但其保留由时间递归支配，导致旧观测随时间衰减。我们提出 SMART，一种由区域令牌寻址的槽记忆，它将有界存储与空间寻址回忆相结合。SMART 将内容存储在恒定大小的槽递归中，其写入由观测相机寻址，其读取由渲染相机查询，而无需构建显式 3D 表示或维护不断增长的缓存。因此，回忆取决于视图间几何，而非时间新近性。每次读取还提供一个置信度估计，用以调制分块因果扩散 transformer，使其能够选择性信任检索到的内容，而在其他地方依赖其生成先验。在 Memory Maze 和 Minecraft 的长轨迹上，SMART 在远超其训练时域的情况下保持高保真回忆，同时使用恒定内存和每步恒定开销。

title: Write Once, Plan Many: Building Reusable Visual Planning Systems from One Scene
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can reason about visual planning tasks, but querying them for every instance incurs repeated inference cost and latency. Generating reusable planning programs offers an alternative, but constructing reliable planning systems for new problem domains without extensive supervision remains challenging. We present a training-free framework that constructs reusable perception and planning programs from a domain specification and a single practice scene without a paired solution. The central challenge is obtaining useful feedback from the limited input. Our framework addresses it by leveraging VLM's ability to provide a renderer and a dynamic model based on its scene understanding. Rendering detected states enables comparison with the practice scene, while checking simulated action outcomes against the domain specification helps expose errors in rule implementation. Together, these checks guide refinement of the grounding program and planner without requiring solution labels. After refinement and component selection, the programs are frozen and solve new instances without further VLM calls. The same framework constructs systems across domains without manual pipeline redesign. Across fifteen domain variants spanning 2D and 3D scenes with discrete and continuous state, our systems achieve 99.3% average planning success, compared with 80.9% for the strongest domain-level program-generation baseline and 90.7% for the strongest instance-level baseline. Cost analyses show a favorable success-cost trade-off, and ablations confirm the contributions of the executable domain model, execution feedback, and component selection.

AI.title_zh: 一次编写，多次规划：从单一场景构建可复用的视觉规划系统
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够对视觉规划任务进行推理，但为每个实例查询它们会带来重复的推理成本与延迟。生成可复用的规划程序提供了一种替代方案，但在没有大量监督的情况下，为新问题领域构建可靠的规划系统仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种免训练框架，它仅凭一个领域规范和一个单一练习场景（无需配对解决方案）即可构建可复用的感知与规划程序。核心挑战在于从有限的输入中获得有用的反馈。我们的框架通过利用 VLM 基于其场景理解提供渲染器和动态模型的能力来应对这一挑战。渲染检测到的状态使其能够与练习场景进行比较，而将模拟动作结果与领域规范进行核对有助于暴露规则实现中的错误。这些检查共同指导对 grounding 程序和规划器的改进，且无需解决方案标签。在改进与组件选择之后，程序被冻结，并在无需进一步 VLM 调用的情况下求解新实例。同一框架可跨领域构建系统，而无需手动重新设计流水线。在涵盖 2D 与 3D 场景、离散与连续状态的十五个领域变体中，我们的系统实现了 99.3% 的平均规划成功率，而最强的领域级程序生成基线为 80.9%，最强的实例级基线为 90.7%。成本分析显示出有利的成功率-成本权衡，消融实验证实了可执行领域模型、执行反馈和组件选择的贡献。

title: Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Models for Consistent Future Frame Prediction
comment: 32 pages, 18 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://anton-arapin.github.io/d3wm-site
summary: World models of visual information predict future image frames conditioned on given action sequences. This predicted scene evolution is driven by deterministic changes such as controlled motion on a robot platform, as well as stochastic changes such as rendering of manipulated objects or previously occluded regions. Our key insight is that the spatial location of these stochastic changes is itself learnable. We leverage this insight by jointly regressing both the deterministic next-state prediction and the spatial uncertainty map, then using the uncertainty map to guide a conditional diffusion process. We propose Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model (D3WM), which uses a transformer trained with a Gaussian negative-log-likelihood objective to produce both the deterministic next-state prediction and a spatial map of heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty. The learned uncertainty map then provides a structured spatial gate for a conditional diffusion model: deterministic regions are anchored to the predicted state, while uncertain regions, such as disocclusions or dynamic textures, are sampled by the diffusion process. We frame this decomposition under a variance-gated stochastic differential equation that separates deterministic drift from stochastic diffusion. D3WM shows improved results over competitive baselines in two distinct types of action spaces: robotic tabletop manipulation and camera motion.

AI.title_zh: 解耦漂移-扩散世界模型用于一致的未来帧预测
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉信息的世界模型以给定动作序列为条件预测未来图像帧。这种预测的场景演化既由确定性变化驱动，例如机器人平台上的受控运动，也由随机变化驱动，例如被操控物体或先前被遮挡区域的渲染。我们的关键洞见是，这些随机变化的空间位置本身是可学习的。我们利用这一洞见，联合回归确定性的下一状态预测与空间不确定性图，然后使用该不确定性图来引导一个条件扩散过程。我们提出解耦漂移-扩散世界模型（Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model，D3WM），它使用一个以高斯负对数似然目标训练的 transformer，同时生成确定性的下一状态预测和一张异方差偶然不确定性（heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty）的空间图。所学习到的不确定性图随后为条件扩散模型提供一个结构化的空间门控：确定性区域被锚定到预测状态，而不确定区域，例如去遮挡（disocclusion）或动态纹理，则由扩散过程采样。我们将这一分解置于一个方差门控的随机微分方程之下，该方程将确定性漂移与随机扩散分离开来。在两类不同的动作空间——机器人桌面操作与相机运动——中，D3WM 相较具有竞争力的基线均展现出改进的结果。

title: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
summary: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. LidarVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics across all three evaluation protocols, while its tokenizer supports 32-, 64-, and 128-beam LiDAR and generalizes to an unseen scanning pattern. These results demonstrate that generative and reconstruction-grounded LiDAR simulation can be realized within one model, providing the core capabilities for future closed-loop sensor simulation.

AI.title_zh: 走进 LidarVerse：一个跨任务与跨传感器的实时统一 LiDAR 世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LidarVerse，一个跨任务与跨传感器的实时统一 LiDAR 世界模型，用于传感器仿真。现有的 LiDAR 模拟器大体上遵循两种互补范式之一：基于重建的方法能够保留所捕获场景的几何结构，但需要针对每个场景进行耗时的优化；而生成式方法则将学习摊销到数据上，但缺乏长时程推演所需的一致性。LidarVerse 将这两种范式纳入单一、统一的条件生成框架之中。一个通用分词器（universal tokenizer）将 LiDAR 距离序列映射到共享潜在空间，其中双向教师模型学习一个通用接口，用于以 LiDAR 前缀、HD-Map、持久化空间缓存以及可选的文本作为条件。改变可用的场景证据，可将同一模型转变为新世界的生成器、点云预测器，或无需逐场景优化的、对已观测场景的可泛化重仿真器（resimulator）。我们将教师模型蒸馏为四步自回归因果学生模型，并同时维护滚动时间 K/V 缓存和世界对齐的空间缓存，从而在单块 H100 GPU 上以 11 FPS 实现实时推理下的持久长时程推演。LidarVerse 在所有三种评估协议下的大多数报告指标上均达到最先进性能，同时其分词器支持 32、64 和 128 线 LiDAR，并能泛化到未见过的扫描模式。这些结果表明，生成式与基于重建的 LiDAR 仿真可以在一个模型中实现，为未来的闭环传感器仿真提供了核心能力。

title: Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization
summary: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. We demonstrate that training on these future outcomes as goals for goal-conditioned BC policies significantly improves generalization in stitching-based OGBench tasks.

AI.title_zh: 以几何视界模型想象目标以实现策略泛化
AI.abstract_zh: 从离线数据中进行训练已在机器人等领领域取得了实质性进展，催生了通用策略，这些策略可以轻松地零样本应用，或被高效地微调以用于下游任务。然而，这些策略的泛化能力仍可能很差，这既源于建模目标的选择，也源于从静态数据集中学习。在本工作中，我们关注零样本目标泛化这一具有挑战性的任务，即在一个策略未见过的任务上评估该策略，而这些任务要求组合其已有知识（组合泛化）。提升策略泛化能力的一条途径是利用世界模型生成新的经验；然而，这种生成在更长的视界上已被证明是困难的。因此，为缓解这一问题，我们提出 TD-Aug，它从几何视界模型（geometric horizon model）中采样，并允许直接想象可通过组合已有知识达成的新颖结果。我们证明，将这些未来结果作为目标用于目标条件 BC 策略的训练，可显著提升基于拼接的 OGBench 任务中的泛化能力。

title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, Under review at Artificial Intelligence Review
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

AI.title_zh: 走向以数据为中心理解多模态大语言模型中的空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已被广泛应用于具身智能体和机器人学中的视觉任务。然而，MLLMs 在空间推理与感知方面存在局限。后训练技术已显示出提升这些能力的潜力；但对此类方法的数据驱动综述仍然有限。在本综述中，我们考察针对空间推理任务对预训练 MLLMs 进行微调的各种方法，涵盖从监督学习到强化学习，并侧重于所使用的数据集。我们探讨数据集构建、数据模态与标注，以及所得模型的评估等主题。基于这些主题，我们将研究划分为三类：数据集设计、数据集构建与评估。我们发现构建固定空间标注的四种主要方法：规则与模板、LLM 提示、程序化生成，以及人在回路（human-in-the-loop）。我们还观察到评估方法存在显著差异，包括不同的评分方法、容差指标和基准类型。最后，我们指出未来研究的机会：统一的动态标注、高效的空间推理、评估的标准化、扩展的空间范围，以及以人为中心的空间交互。

title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
summary: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.

AI.title_zh: GroundGUI：通过高质量数据与蒸馏到强化学习实现的GUI定位
AI.abstract_zh: 构建稳健的GUI智能体依赖于多模态视觉定位：即将自然语言意图精确映射到屏幕上可操作组件的能力。尽管桌面、网页和移动端基准已相当丰富，但针对多样化环境定制的高保真资源却出乎意料地稀缺。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了Screen Referring Grounding Dataset（ScreenRef），这是一个全面的GUI定位数据集，由GUI截图与自然语言指代表达以及框或点标注配对组成。ScreenRef跨越桌面、网页和移动端领域，包含586K张截图和超过633K个指代表达实例，覆盖文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解和拒绝场景等任务。为提升模型的定位性能，我们提出了Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning（D2RL）方法，以解决监督微调泛化能力有限以及强化学习中奖励稀疏的问题。利用ScreenRef，我们通过顺序的SFT和D2RL训练对Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct进行训练，得到GroundGUI-8B。GroundGUI-8B在ScreenSpot-V2上达到95.2%，在ScreenSpot-Pro上达到63.9%，在OSWorld-G上达到65.4%，在MMBench-GUI L2上达到86.8%，在UI-Vision上达到38.3%。在8B规模模型中，它相较在开源数据集上训练的模型取得了显著提升，性能可与在闭源数据上训练的模型相当甚至更优。代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI获取。

title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
summary: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. Across 260 test cases, it assesses static memory through the retention of human identity and appearance, object appearance and geometry, and environmental content and geometry, and dynamic memory through event progression and state persistence. Using controlled camera departures and multi-revisit trajectories, the benchmark evaluates static content against fixed initial references and dynamic events against expected state transitions. It combines appearance and geometry metrics with event-specific assessments, and reports video quality and camera-following accuracy as complementary diagnostics. Evaluation of nine representative models shows that strong static retention does not imply reliable dynamic state evolution, while repeated revisits reveal memory degradation beyond the first return. Human studies support the alignment between our automatic evaluations and human judgments. WorldMemBench provides a systematic testbed for diagnosing memory failures and guiding the development of persistent, temporally coherent video worlds.

AI.title_zh: WorldMemBench：视频世界模型记忆能力的综合基准
AI.abstract_zh: 随着视频模型能够支持更长、更逼真的交互体验，维持与其历史一致的世界变得至关重要。这既需要保留此前观察到的内容，也需要确保世界随时间连贯演化。世界记忆是与视觉保真度和视频时长并列的一项关键能力，需要加以评估。我们提出 WorldMemBench，一个用于系统评估视频世界模型世界记忆能力的基准。它在 260 个测试用例中，通过人类身份与外观、物体外观与几何、环境内容与几何的保持来评估静态记忆，并通过事件进展与状态持续性来评估动态记忆。该基准利用受控的相机离开与多次重访轨迹，针对固定的初始参考评估静态内容，并针对预期的状态转移评估动态事件。它结合外观与几何指标以及事件特定评估，并将视频质量和相机跟随准确度作为补充诊断指标进行报告。对九个代表性模型的评估表明，强大的静态保持能力并不意味着可靠的动态状态演化，而多次重访则揭示出在第一次返回之后出现的记忆退化。人类研究支持我们的自动评估与人类判断之间的一致性。WorldMemBench 提供了一个系统化的测试平台，用于诊断记忆失败并指导持久、时间连贯的视频世界的开发。

title: Action Jets: Learning the Local Shape of the Action-conditioned Data Manifold
summary: World models are a powerful means of reasoning and planning, but many of these action-conditioned predictive models are high dimensional and computationally expensive. These challenges limit the number of action candidates that can be evaluated by a planner. We show that this cost is avoidable for planners over short horizons, which only require local information with respect to the current state. For a fixed state, the frames reachable by varying a low-dimensional action (a camera movement or an end-effector command) lie on a low-dimensional manifold. We estimate the local shape of that manifold directly via a network trained to estimate how each image region moves per unit of each action axis supervised by data collected from samples by the generator. A correction head fit to trajectory data estimates the shape of this manifold region up to a third-order Taylor polynomial. We call this network estimating the Taylor polynomial describing the manifold shape an Action Jet and compute its radius of validity in closed form. By traversing this approximation of the local manifold shape, we only have to perform inference once per state for any number of candidate actions. Scoring sixteen candidates from a single extraction is over 300x faster than with either source generator, and this gap widens with the number of candidates a planner evaluates. We measure against state-of-the-art action-conditioned generators, IRASim and WorldGym on BridgeData V2, a real 7-DoF manipulation benchmark, and FrameCrafter on DL3DV scenes, where we chart from the novel-view generators DepthSplat and LagerNVS. Because only the tangent comes from the generator and every other term from the data, the Action Jet also predicts held-out frames more accurately than IRASim, the generator that supplied its tangent, at short horizons and at over 100x less compute.

AI.title_zh: 动作射流：学习动作条件数据流形的局部形状
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型是进行推理与规划的有力手段，但其中许多动作条件预测模型维度高且计算代价昂贵。这些挑战限制了规划器所能评估的动作候选数量。我们表明，对于短时域上的规划器而言，这一代价是可以避免的，因为它们只需要相对于当前状态的局部信息。对于固定状态，通过改变低维动作（相机运动或末端执行器指令）所能到达的帧位于一个低维流形上。我们通过一个网络直接估计该流形的局部形状，该网络被训练用于估计每个图像区域在每个动作轴的单位变化下如何移动，并由生成器采样收集的数据进行监督。一个拟合轨迹数据的校正头将该流形区域的形状估计到三阶泰勒多项式。我们将这个估计描述流形形状的泰勒多项式的网络称为动作射流（Action Jet），并以闭式形式计算其有效半径。通过遍历这一局部流形形状的近似，对于任意数量的候选动作，我们只需对每个状态执行一次推理。从单次提取中为十六个候选打分，比使用任一源生成器快 300 倍以上，而且随着规划器评估的候选数量增加，这一差距还会扩大。我们在 BridgeData V2 这一真实 7 自由度操作基准上与最先进的动作条件生成器 IRASim 和 WorldGym 进行对比，并在 DL3DV 场景上与 FrameCrafter 进行对比，其中我们还绘制了来自新视角生成器 DepthSplat 和 LagerNVS 的结果。由于只有切向量来自生成器，而其他每一项都来自数据，Action Jet 在短时域上还比提供其切向量的生成器 IRASim 更准确地预测留出帧，且计算量少 100 倍以上。

title: Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid policies trained in simulation can transfer qualitatively to hardware while failing to transfer the force interactions learned during training, compromising torque efficiency, load regulation, and robustness to impacts. This failure can arise from actuator sim-to-real gaps because forces depend on actuator torques. We introduce Contact-UAN, a residual world model that preserves a simulator's physics priors while correcting actuator dynamics to align simulated rollouts with recorded hardware rollouts. For humanoid motion with contact, this requires contact-consistent replay: if hardware playback in simulation begins with misaligned contact wrenches, the residual model learns to correct reset artifacts rather than actuator discrepancies. Using only onboard proprioception, Contact-UAN infers the simulator-side stance-foot pose needed to initialize replay with consistent contact forces. We show that a UAN trained on 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data generalizes to tasks that benefit from accurate force and impulse regulation and produces policies that transfer seamlessly to the real world, yielding 20% lower running torque, 43% lower force-tracking error, extreme compliance, accurate impedance control, and dynamic, robust jumps.

AI.title_zh: Contact-UAN：作为人形控制残差世界模型的无监督执行器网络
AI.abstract_zh: 在仿真中训练的人形策略可以定性地迁移到硬件上，但却无法迁移训练期间学到的力交互，从而损害力矩效率、负载调节能力和对冲击的鲁棒性。这种失败可能源于执行器的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距，因为力依赖于执行器力矩。我们提出 Contact-UAN，一种残差世界模型，它保留仿真器的物理先验，同时校正执行器动力学，使仿真推演与记录的硬件推演对齐。对于带接触的人形运动，这要求接触一致的复现（replay）：如果硬件在仿真中的回放开始时接触力旋量（contact wrench）未对齐，残差模型会学习去校正重置伪影（reset artifact），而非执行器差异。仅使用本体感觉（onboard proprioception），Contact-UAN 推断出仿真侧的支撑脚位姿，从而以一致的接触力初始化回放。我们表明，一个在 6.5 分钟真实世界行走数据上训练的 UAN 可以泛化到受益于精确力和冲量调节的任务，并产生可无缝迁移到真实世界的策略，实现运行力矩降低 20%、力跟踪误差降低 43%、极致的柔顺性、精确的阻抗控制，以及动态且稳健的跳跃。
